description: Whole-repo orientation in one dense CTX-PACK/0.1 text block (~200-400 tokens): directory rollups with lines-of-code and 6-month commit heat, the largest and hottest files, cross-directory import edges, and entry-point candidates. The header declares the row schema (D dir, F file, E edge, X entry), so the block is self-describing. Call this FIRST in a new repo — it replaces several exploratory listings with one read. Git unavailable degrades honestly (heat columns 0, noted in a comment).

rootPath.description: Directory to pack (e.g. the project's src/). Default: the workspace root.

topFiles.description: How many largest files get F rows (default 10). Files with 3+ recent commits are always included.

name: get_context_pack
